title: The Menu, Week 4
dek: Three starting quarterbacks and five lead backs are off the menu, Kenneth Walker III is RB3, Jaylen Warren is a top-10 back on Thursday night, and Jayden Daniels sits outside the top 24 until he practices.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Thu 12:45 PM ET: Rachaad White sat a second straight practice in London, and his row and Jacory Croskey-Merritt's carry it; no rank moves.

Updated Thu 12:30 PM ET: DeVonta Smith carries a hamstring flag after sitting out Wednesday's walkthrough, the same pattern as last week when he played, and Dallas Goedert's off-menu note carries his Wednesday DNP; no rank moves.

Updated Wed 7:30 PM ET: Ladd McConkey carries a foot flag after a limited Wednesday, and the Judkins row carries Cleveland's center ruled out for Thursday night; no rank moves.

Updated Wed 6:30 PM ET: Rico Dowdle is ruled out for Thursday night and Jaylen Warren's row carries it, Bucky Irving (glute, limited), Chris Godwin (ankle, DNP), Lamar Jackson (back, limited) and Zay Flowers (hamstring, limited) carry Wednesday's flags, Jeanty practiced in full, Josh Allen is off the report, and the Stafford and Adams notes carry Puka Nacua's limited return; no rank moves, the order moves Friday.

Updated Wed 3:45 PM ET: Drake Maye and Kyler Murray come off the QB1 and stream lines and TreVeyon Henderson out of the flex, Romeo Doubs is a flex with Mack Hollins as the A.J. Brown pivot, and the Jeanty, Gordon, Stevenson and Likely rows carry Wednesday's usage and practice facts; no rank moves, the order moves Friday.

Updated Wed 3:40 PM ET: Kenyon Sadiq is a START with Mason Taylor expected out again, Geno Smith and Sam Darnold are STREAMs, DK Metcalf and Emeka Egbuka are FLEX on both lists, Jadarian Price and Chris Godwin are SITs, Ted Hurst III is a full-time TB receiver, and the Jalen Hurts, Braelon Allen, Dontayvion Wicks, Tony Pollard and Wan'Dale Robinson notes carry the usage; no rank moves until Friday's Prep Notes.

Updated Wed 3:35 PM ET: David Montgomery is a flex on both lists (the snaps are close to even over three games), Daniel Jones moves from sit to stream (a three-man tree and a WAS pass defense that has allowed 11 passing touchdowns), Jake Ferguson and Brian Thomas Jr. move from stream and flex to sit on their snap and route shares, Jayden Reed is out for the season after neck surgery, Nico Collins was limited Wednesday, and the Javonte Williams, Bo Nix, Matthew Golden, C.J. Stroud, Woody Marks and Kenneth Walker III notes are corrected; no rank moves.

Updated Wed 3:30 PM ET: Khalil Shakir is a SIT after 3 targets while DJ Moore drew 10, Quinshon Judkins is a FLEX on both lists with his Week 3 opponent fixed to CAR, DJ Moore's flex row now agrees with his WR3 start, Chuba Hubbard's line is 19 carries, and the Lamar Jackson, Derrick Henry, Bryce Young, Josh Allen, James Cook, Mark Andrews, Kyle Pitts, Zay Flowers, Jeremiyah Love and Harold Fannin Jr. notes carry Wednesday's facts; no rank moves until Friday's Prep Notes.

Updated Wed 2:20 PM ET: Colston Loveland's Week 3 line is 4 of 4 for 31 yards, not 34, and his row now carries his 10 percent target share; no rank moves.

Updated Wed 11:20 AM ET: Rachaad White carries a flag after sitting out Wednesday's session with the shoulder, Jalen McMillan is on IR, which changes nothing, since he played 9 snaps all season and Ted Hurst III has played 75 percent of the snaps every week next to Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin, and CHI starts Tyson Bagent vs NYJ if he practices all week. The order is this morning's: Kenneth Walker III at RB3, Jaylen Warren at RB10, Jaxon Smith-Njigba the WR1, and Marcus Mariota as the WAS quarterback with Jayden Daniels outside the top 24 after a limited jog-through in London. Puka Nacua, Justin Jefferson and Mike Evans sit outside the ranked depth until they practice; Prep Notes brings them back Friday if they do.

Week 4 has no byes and a lot of empty chairs. Caleb Williams, Baker Mayfield and Jaxson Dart are out at quarterback, De'Von Achane and Jordan Mason are on IR, Travis Etienne is out for Monday night, Rico Dowdle has not practiced on a short week, and Breece Hall is week to week. Every one of them has a pivot listed under Off the Menu. Rankings are for full PPR.

The biggest moves come from the snap counts, not the box scores. Warren is a top-10 back with 90 percent of the snaps and 20 touches in Dowdle's absence before Thursday's game at CLE. Chuba Hubbard and Aaron Jones Sr. are RB2s on deployment: 19 carries and 84 percent of the snaps for Hubbard, 78 percent of Minnesota's carries for Jones against the defense that has allowed the most points to running backs. Omarion Hampton lost his passing downs, Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin have an undrafted rookie at quarterback, and Brian Thomas Jr. is playing 37 percent of the snaps.

Nico Collins carries a flag at WR15: he has not practiced since the hamstring and needs a session by Friday. Prep Notes revisits every flag Friday after the final injury report and updates this page.
outro_md: Tiers are courses. The top of a tier is the safest plate; the bottom is where the flags live. A questionable player keeps his action and carries the flag until Friday. Specials are matchup plays outside the top tiers, and Off the Menu names the pivot for every player who is out.
